issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one private GCP platform foundation for disposable workloads.

## Primary deliverable

One private GCP platform foundation providing approved operator access, storage classes, telemetry, and zero-residue disposal.

## Verification result

VPC, subnet, IAP and OS Login, egress, firewall, artifact/model/evidence storage, logging, metric, label, watchdog, and disposable non-GPU workload checks pass.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one private platform foundation; network storage observability and disposable-workload components cannot close independently.

## Dependencies

- GCP-C: #492

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No unintended public route address or ingress exists
- [ ] Human and workload identities are separate
- [ ] State artifacts models continuity evidence and logs have separate owners
- [ ] A disposable non-GPU workload is destroyed with zero residue

## Owned paths

- `infra/gcp/platform/**`
- `docs/operations/cloud/gcp/platform-foundation/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/gcp-d/**`

## PVF lanes

- `private-network`
- `operator-access`
- `data-class-boundaries`
- `telemetry-and-watchdog`
- `disposable-workload-cleanup`

## Stop conditions

- Public exposure appears
- Required IAM is broad or key-based
- Cleanup selectors are incomplete

## Non-goals

- GPU qualification
- Production traffic
- Shared-VPC expansion
